# Booking component notices

NEXG's booking runtime uses the MIT-licensed Payload CMS core and Payload Reserve. Their copyright and permission notices must accompany copies containing the software. Commercial NEXG merchant subscriptions do not require royalties under those inspected licenses. Other dependencies and optional services retain their own terms.

Pinned source evidence:

- Payload Reserve 4.4.2, inspected commit fd937bdb6222ff469687b6c91bf88e4f262c6f0a: https://github.com/elghaied/payload-reserve/blob/fd937bdb6222ff469687b6c91bf88e4f262c6f0a/LICENSE
- Payload CMS 3.86.0: https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/blob/v3.86.0/LICENSE.md

The deployed runtime must retain dependency LICENSE files. The portal serves the corresponding core notices at `/licenses/booking.txt`. Upgrades require checking actual versions, dependency notices and any separately licensed add-on. No premium calendar or proprietary Payload enterprise product has been selected by this implementation.
